name: atlas-core
description: Plataforma de IA para gestão de pequenas empresas via WhatsApp.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @atlas/dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,whatsapp,dashboard -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @atlas/api" "npm run dev -w @atlas/whatsapp" "npm run dev -w @atlas/dashboard"
